hero.h1_classes: text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl font-bold uppercase tracking-tighter text-white leading-[0.9]
hero.cta_classes: inline-block px-12 py-5 bg-white text-black font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-lg hover:bg-red-600 hover:text-white transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 shadow-2xl shadow-white/10

keyframes_css: @keyframes glitch { 0% { transform: translate(0) } 20% { transform: translate(-2px, 2px) } 40% { transform: translate(-2px, -2px) } 60% { transform: translate(2px, 2px) } 80% { transform: translate(2px, -2px) } 100% { transform: translate(0) } }
